# Sakai Platform

> Sakai is a modern fullstack micro-frontend web application built with Angular 22 and PrimeNG, providing real-time analytics, administrative management, and secure cross-domain authentication.

## Core Navigation
- [Home](http://localhost:4001/#home): Sakai landing page hero, high-level metrics, and platform introduction.
- [Features](http://localhost:4001/#features): Enterprise features, modular micro-frontends, and cloud integration.
- [Highlights](http://localhost:4001/#highlights): Technical architecture, real-time performance, and developer experience.
- [Pricing](http://localhost:4001/#pricing): Flexible subscription tiers including Free, Startup, and Enterprise plans.

## Platform Micro-Frontends
- [Dashboard](http://localhost:4000/): Interactive data visualization, system analytics, and administrative workspace.
- [Authentication](http://localhost:4002/login): Secure user login, session management, and self-service registration portal.
